headline: China's State Council reviews AI+ progress and emphasizes industrial deployment, compute-energy coordination and risk control
summary: China's State Council executive meeting on 16 October 2026 heard a report on progress under the national AI+ action. Its public readout calls for application-led innovation, stronger AI technology and algorithm work, compute–electricity coordination, more high-quality data, joint R&D and pilot validation focused on the real economy, expanded application scenarios, and risk assessment and controls adapted by sector. The report documents central policy priorities; it does not identify a new funding instrument, named implementation program, targets, or measured outcomes.
